description:
UNO (La Tempesta, 2023) is the 3rd full album by Daykoda - music project led by the Milan based producer and musician Andrea Gamba, that experiments in contaminations with electronic, jazz, and experimental hip-hop.

His work has received support by national and international media realities such as BBC Radio, Mary Anne Hobbs, KCRW, Rai Radio, Nubya Garcia (NTS Radio), Lefto (Worldwide FM), Laurent Garnier and more


UNO is a twelve tracks experimenting electronica, contemporary jazz, indie soul and ambient, featuring American producer and musician Jason Wool aka WOOLYMAMMOTH. The singer and composer Naima Faraò and the Scottish trombonist corto.alto, a talented member of the Glasgow jazz scene.

"An ambitious and eclectic album that explores a wide range of genres and themes. It is a testament to Daykoda’s creativity and talent, and it is sure to appeal to fans of electronica, jazz, and beyond."
